title.space: Title of the dialog that creates a Space (a shared area for a team's pages and chats). Light and friendly.
title.dotEdit: Title of the dialog that edits a socio (an AI agent; internally a Dot). Light and friendly.
title.dotNew: Title of the dialog that creates a socio (AI agent), each one a specialist. Light and friendly.
title.memory: Title of the dialog that saves a memory: a preference or fact the socios keep in mind.
title.schedule: Title of the dialog that schedules a task for a socio (AI agent) to repeat. Light and friendly.
close: Accessible name of the X button that closes the dialog (read by screen readers).
name: Label of the name field when creating a Space or creating or editing a socio (AI agent).
text.dot: Label of the instructions that give a new socio (AI agent) its role.
text.space: Label of a new Space's description.
text.memory: Label of the text of a new memory: a preference or fact the socios (AI agents) keep in mind.
text.schedule: Label of the task a socio (AI agent) should repeat on a schedule in this chat.
dotPlaceholder: Example instructions for a new socio (AI agent), written to the socio.
spaces.legend: Which Spaces (shared areas of pages) the socio may use. Keep "Space" capitalized if your language allows.
spaces.note: Under the Space access heading in a socio's dialog: tick the Spaces this socio (AI agent) may read and edit pages in.
spaces.default: Label of the select of the Space where this socio (AI agent) saves new pages by default.
spaces.choose: Placeholder option of the default Space select.
research.title: Switch: the socio may read public web pages.
memories.title: Switch: the socio may use the person's saved memories (preferences).
share.title: Switch (admins, new socio): everyone in the workspace can use the socio.
visibility: Who sees a personal socio (AI agent). The workspace variant is for a socio shared with everyone.
issues.title: Switch (admins): the socio may file items on the Improvements board (the product's feedback board; a product name).
model.label: The AI model new chats with this socio start on.
model.inherit: Option: no fixed model; each person's own AI subscription is used, else the workspace's.
learning.legend: "Learning" is a product feature that learns skills from finished conversations; keep it capitalized.
learning.container: Label: the ID of the Learning container (a group of related conversations). "ID" is an identifier.
learning.placeholder: Example container ID: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
learning.skillsTitle: Switch: the socio uses the skills Learning published for its container.
dataLinks: Footer of a socio's dialog, with two links to other pages. Keep the tags around the link words.
schedule.label: How often a scheduled task repeats.
schedule.hour: Option of how often a scheduled task repeats.
schedule.day: Option of how often a scheduled task repeats.
schedule.week: Option of how often a scheduled task repeats.
webSaveFailed: Error after the socio saved but its web identity didn't.
character.legend: A socio's (AI agent's) look: one of the mascot characters.
character.label: Accessible name of a character choice. {{name}} is its name, {{kind}} what it is (such as "fox"), both from the product.
archive.title: What archiving does: the socio leaves every list (not deleted). The archived variant is shown once it's archived.
archive.body: What archiving a socio (AI agent) does, next to the Archive button. The _archived form is shown on an archived socio, next to the Unarchive button: what unarchiving does.
archive.archive: Button: asks to archive the socio; a second click confirms.
archive.unarchive: Button: brings an archived socio back.
web.legend: How the socio (AI agent) appears to websites it reads.
web.label: Label of the select choosing how this socio (AI agent) identifies itself to the websites it reads.
web.default: Option: follows the workspace's default, named in parentheses: the browser (base key) or a declared agent (the agent variant).
web.agent: Option: the socio identifies itself as an agent. http_get and http_json are tool names (code).
web.browser: Option: the socio reads through a browser on its own computer.
web.help: Help under the select. User-Agent is the HTTP header (keep it); {{userAgent}} its value (code); /agents is a page address (code); {{count}} the most reads a minute per website.
